Northwind Ceramics

We are a studio pottery in Leeds. Everything is wheel-thrown and wood-fired in small batches. The studio was founded in 1998.

Firing

The anagama kiln is fired twice a year and each firing runs for four days. Ash from the pine deposits on the pots and forms the glaze.

Visitors are welcome on the first Saturday of each month.

A dinner plate is 38 pounds. A large serving bowl is 145 pounds. Commissions start at 400 pounds.

Delivery

We ship within the UK only. Orders are packed by hand and take a week. Everything travels double-boxed in shredded paper rather than plastic, which is slower to pack and is the reason for the week. Large pieces go by pallet and we will quote for those separately. Breakages in transit are replaced or refunded, whichever the buyer prefers, and we ask for a photograph of the packaging as well as the piece.

Visiting

The studio is on Kirkstall Road. Parking is on the street.
